mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following FEDFUNDS below 12-month moving average show no significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate signals labor market deterioration that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances with UNRATE increase >0.3pp or mean return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate contracting private sector demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or joint signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 12-month moving average or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to its 3-month moving average indicates strong private sector demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS > 3-month moving average or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in >50% of cases with CPIAUCSL YoY >3.5% or mean return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that precedes corporate cost-cutting and reduced consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise from prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or joint signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), an increase in the federal funds rate signals further policy restraint that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
